label: LOCAL_SIMULATION
kind: outage and recovery on the compose-built Avalanche stack (not Fuji)

steps.step: setup: users, throwaway wallets linked, simulated USDC minted (LOCAL only)
O1 gateway unavailable: read and record refused, no business effect; after the restart the same hash is recorded once and applied once
O2 RPC unavailable: the API degrades without changing business state; it reads FUNDED again after the RPC returns
O3 Anvil restart: the chain keeps its state (volume), the escrow still reads FUNDED, nothing is re-applied
O4 backend restart: the first party signature survives, the second signature completes the pair, the refund is applied once
O5 database unavailable: reads fail instead of answering wrongly; after the restart the state is unchanged and both services serve again
steps.marketplaceWhileDown: The operation was aborted due to timeout

steps.step: O6 pending transaction: recorded but not applied while unmined; applied once after it is mined and finalized
O7 reverted transaction: refused or recorded as reverted, never applied
O7b a normal funding retry on the same contract succeeds afterwards
